scripts.text: - I show my ring to Arc and explain everything including how I ended up here... -
scripts.translation: - 我向阿克展示戒指，並把事情經過告訴了他，包括我是如何來到這裡的...... -
原來如此......嗯，事情是這樣的......

scripts.text: The source of that huge shock and mysterious explosion...
scripts.translation: 那個巨大沖擊和神秘爆炸的源頭......

scripts.text: That's why you humans were exploring here and there...
scripts.translation: 原來你們人類一直在到處探索...

scripts.text: Now I clearly understand that you are not sent by the giants of Manuk.
scripts.translation: 現在我明白了，你不是馬努克巨人派來的。

scripts.text: Thank you for telling me these interesting stories.
scripts.translation: 謝謝你告訴我這些有趣的事。

scripts.text: We use different languages as expected...
scripts.translation: 看來我們果然使用不同的語言......

scripts.text: I might mispronunce it, so please understand...
scripts.translation: 我可能會念錯，請多包涵......

scripts.text: Anyways, I have a favor to ask you. Is it okay?
scripts.translation: 總之，我有件事想拜託你。可以嗎？

scripts.text: - Arc looks around to check if someone else is around. Satisfied you're alone he continues with his story in a low tone. -
scripts.translation: - 阿克環顧四周，確認附近沒人後，才壓低聲音繼續說。 -

scripts.text: Frankly, I'm worried about a friend of mine who left without permission saying that she's going to check on your camp. She hasn't come back since then.
scripts.translation: 老實說，我很擔心一個朋友。她未經許可就離開了，說要去檢視你們的營地。從那以後她就沒回來。

scripts.text: But, I can't leave this post to look for her 'cause I have a duty to guard the research data stored here.
scripts.translation: 可是我不能擅離崗位去找她，因為我有責任守護存放在這裡的研究資料。

scripts.text: Since she left without permission, I can't even report to my superiors... that will just end up as a bigger problem.
scripts.translation: 她未經許可就離開了，我甚至沒法向上級報告......那隻會讓事情變得更糟。

scripts.text: The thought of it just worries me...
As a matter of fact, we are trying not to have any contact with the giants of Manuk so we stay away from each other's territory.
scripts.translation: 事實上，我們儘量避免和馬努克巨人接觸，所以彼此都不進入對方的領地。

scripts.text: That camp of yours is located in the area that has been acting as the neutral zone between our two races...
scripts.translation: 你們的營地位於我們兩族之間的中立地帶......

scripts.text: If she has gotten close to their side then she might have gone over to the snow fields...
scripts.translation: 如果她已經靠近他們的領地，可能去了雪原......

scripts.text: That will make it even more difficult for us to look for her...
scripts.translation: 那樣我們就更難找到她了......

scripts.text: The Manuk giants might misunderstand this as provoking them...Couldn't they?
scripts.translation: 馬努克巨人可能會把這當成挑釁......不是嗎？

scripts.text: So...the point is, you want me to look for your friend. Right?
scripts.translation: 所以，你是想讓我去找你的朋友，對吧？

scripts.text: Because you can't do it yourself from all these complicated situations?
scripts.translation: 局勢這麼複雜，你自己沒法離開崗位去找她？

scripts.text: But, I'm going to need more information if I'm going to look for her.
scripts.translation: 不過，要找她的話，我需要更多線索。

scripts.text: You don't have to worry about that...
^4d4dffTerra^000000 has a habit of making a knot out of plants to mark her destination.
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff泰拉^000000習慣用打結的植物標記自己走過的地方。

scripts.text: She does it so that she won't get lost.
scripts.translation: 她這樣做是為了防止迷路。

scripts.text: If you find a trail of knotted plants it should lead you to where she is.
scripts.translation: 如果你發現一串打結的植物，順著它們應該就能找到她。

scripts.text: It can be hard to look for them, but it's better than doing nothing...
scripts.translation: 找起來可能很困難，但總比什麼都不做強......

scripts.text: Ah, and please keep this a secret from the other Laphines.
scripts.translation: 還有，請對其他拉斐族保密。

scripts.text: Remember {0}... you must keep this to yourself...

scripts.text: You were sent here to carry on your own mission...

scripts.text: ^4d4dffTerra^000000 has a habit of making a knot out of plants to mark her destination.
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff泰拉^000000習慣用植物打結來標記去過的地方。

scripts.text: Keep that in mind when searching for her. And don't tell any other Laphine's about her missing.
scripts.translation: 尋找她時請留意這一點。還有，別告訴其他拉斐族她失蹤了。

scripts.text: You {0} are the only one I could ask for help...
Have you found any knotted plants?

scripts.translation: 那就是泰拉留下的標記。

scripts.text: Keep it up and find her

scripts.translation: - 阿克看起來有些不知所措。 -

scripts.text: but, she was covered all over with wounds...
scripts.translation: 她平安回來了！可是她渾身是傷......

scripts.text: She just took the Bradium with that exhausted body!

scripts.text: Didn't even tell me the reason!
I told her no, but she wouldn't listen to me!
scripts.translation: 我明明攔著她，可她根本不聽！

scripts.text: It happened all of a sudden.
What do I have to do?

scripts.text: And I just stood here...doing nothing.
scripts.translation: 而我只是站在這裡......什麼也沒做。

scripts.text: You have a strong sense of responsibility.

scripts.text: Why did she take the Bradium...?

scripts.text: They use a refined Bradium ore...
scripts.translation: 他們會使用精煉過的布拉迪姆......

scripts.text: You said that a Sapha was hurt?
scripts.translation: 你說有個薩法族受傷了？

scripts.text: And its body was already stiff?
- Arc suddenly began gathering up his gear. -

scripts.text: Where was that cave where you found that Sapha?
scripts.translation: 你發現那名薩法族的洞穴在哪裡？

scripts.text: There was no such cave when we inspected our surrounding areas.
scripts.translation: 我們巡查周邊時，根本沒見過這樣的洞穴。

scripts.text: What are you trying to do?
I'm going out to look for Terra. She took the Bradium with her, it has got to be something to do with that Sapha.
scripts.translation: 我要出去找泰拉。她帶走了布拉迪姆，這肯定和那名薩法族有關。

scripts.text: Is it okay for you to leave your post?
Shit, then what should I do!!
I will go. I'm the one who knows exactly where that cave is.
scripts.translation: 我去吧。只有我知道那個洞穴的確切位置。

scripts.text: I will go and bring her back.
If Terra headed for that cave, I should be able to find her.
scripts.translation: 如果泰拉去了那個洞穴，我應該能找到她。

scripts.text: Let's hear rest of the story from Terra.
scripts.translation: 我們先聽泰拉把事情說完吧。

scripts.text: It is important for you to guard this place, isn't it?
scripts.translation: 你得留在這裡守衛，對吧？

scripts.text: If Terra really took the Bradium without any permission...
scripts.translation: 如果泰拉真的未經許可就拿走了布拉迪姆......

scripts.text: The higher ups won't just remain still...
I'm sorry to ask you but...
Please go and bring her back here...
I'm really sorry for getting you into this mess.....
scripts.translation: 真的很抱歉把你捲進這堆麻煩裡......

scripts.text: What? A wounded Laphine in the Sapha's village?
scripts.translation: 什麼？薩法村莊裡有一位受傷的拉斐族？

scripts.text: Was it Terra?! Was she captured by those Sapha bastards?!
scripts.translation: 是泰拉嗎？！她被那些薩法族抓住了嗎？！

scripts.text: Calm down. I couldn't check out exactly who the captured Laphine was.
scripts.translation: 冷靜點。我沒法確認被抓的拉斐族是不是泰拉。

scripts.text: And they seem to have no intention of harming the Laphine.
scripts.translation: 而且他們似乎沒有傷害她的意思。

scripts.text: Also, they were looking for something that can cure a wounded Laphine...
scripts.translation: 另外，他們在找能治療受傷拉斐族的東西......

scripts.text: If we bring some medicine to them, we might have a chance to see who the Laphine is.
scripts.translation: 如果我們給他們帶些藥，也許有機會確認她是誰。

scripts.text: I understand how anxious you feel.. but that is the only way I can think of finding out who it is.
scripts.translation: 我明白你有多著急......但這是我唯一能想到的確認她身份的辦法。

scripts.text: I will take some things to treat the wounds with me and if it turns out that the captured Laphine is Terra, I will bring her back.
scripts.translation: 我會帶些療傷藥過去。如果被抓的拉斐族是泰拉，我就把她帶回來。

scripts.text: OK, that seems like the best thing we can do for this situation...
scripts.translation: ..好吧，看來這是目前我們能做的最好的事了......

scripts.text: Do you by any chance know about the 'Yggdrasil'?
There's nothing better than the Yggdrasilberry to treat wounds...
scripts.translation: 沒有什麼比世界樹果實更適合治療傷口......
尤其對我們拉斐族而言......

scripts.text: If you have a Yggdrasilberry, you can use it to cure that Laphine...
scripts.translation: 如果你有世界樹果實，就可以用它治療那位拉斐族......

scripts.text: .Yggdrasil is the tree of life... its roots are in touch with everything in this world.
scripts.translation: 世界樹是生命之樹，它的根系與世間萬物相連。

scripts.text: I will give you these but they won't be enough...
scripts.translation: 我把這些給你，但數量還不夠......

scripts.text: Outside... there is a huge tree... where the root of the Yggdrasil is exposed.... it should be there.
scripts.translation: 外面有一棵巨樹，世界樹的根在那裡露出地面......果實應該就在附近。

scripts.text: Sometimes you can find Yggdrasilberries around there.
scripts.translation: 有時能在那附近找到世界樹果實。

scripts.text: Go find few more and bring them with you. Hurry!
scripts.translation: 再去找幾顆帶上。快去吧！

scripts.text: There's a huge root of the tree near a swamp at the outskirts of this area.
scripts.translation: 這片區域邊緣的沼澤附近有一根巨大的樹根。

scripts.text: That's where the tree of life's root is exposed.
scripts.translation: 生命之樹的根就在那兒露出地面。

scripts.text: You should be able to find some Yggdrasilberries there.
scripts.translation: 你應該能在那裡找到一些世界樹果實。

scripts.text: You will need at least 6~7 of them...
As soon as you are done collecting the berries, bring them to the Sapha Village right away!!!
scripts.translation: 採到果實後，立刻把它們帶到薩法村莊！！！

scripts.text: She is back in one piece!

scripts.translation: 裡面太黑，什麼也看不見......但感覺底下有個大洞。

scripts.text: I'd better step back...It looks dangerous.
scripts.translation: 還是退後吧......看起來很危險。

scripts.text: Between huge roots, there is a hole leads to the underground cave.
scripts.translation: 巨大的樹根之間有個洞口，通往地下洞穴。

scripts.text: Again, you slip through the muddy roots.
scripts.translation: 你又一次在泥濘的樹根間滑倒了。

scripts.text: You decide to come back later.
Strange looking stems are entangled inside an opening of huge roots.
scripts.translation: 巨大的樹根縫隙裡纏著形狀奇怪的莖蔓。

scripts.text: Surface looks unstable...I should step away before I slip on it.
scripts.translation: 表面很滑......我最好離遠點，免得摔倒。

scripts.text: This is the only spot where sunlight is shining down through a hole in the ceiling.
scripts.translation: 這是唯一有陽光透過天花板洞口照射進來的地方。

scripts.text: Looking up I see the roots of the tree and stems digging up a mud-plastered wall, so the sunlight could shine through....2.j...There is a statue of Giant on the ground.
scripts.translation: 抬頭望去，樹根和莖蔓穿透了覆泥的牆壁，讓陽光照了進來......地上有一尊巨人雕像。

scripts.text: A statue in a place like this...
scripts.translation: 這種地方居然有一尊雕像......

scripts.text: Hm, This resembles... that giant tribe in Manuk...
scripts.translation: 嗯，這看起來像......馬努克的巨人部族......

scripts.text: It has a lot of scars on it... as if it had been in a severe fight...
scripts.translation: 它身上有很多傷疤......看起來經歷過一場惡戰......

scripts.text: And it appears like it's holding something in its arms...
scripts.translation: 它似乎還抱著什麼東西......

scripts.text: I can't imagine what happened here, but I don't see Terra's marks anymore...
scripts.translation: 我不清楚這裡發生了什麼，但已經看不到泰拉留下的標記了......

scripts.text: and this cave looks unsafe... I'd better go back to Arc for now.
scripts.translation: 洞穴看起來也不安全......我先回去找阿克。

scripts.text: Could it be... Terra was fighting this Giant?
scripts.translation: 難道......泰拉和這個巨人戰鬥過？

scripts.text: Anyways... How do I get out of here?
That hole I came in is too slippery to climb back out...
scripts.translation: 進來的洞太滑了，爬不上去......

scripts.text: Light is coming in from the ceiling above... Maybe I should just climb a stem around here...
scripts.translation: 上方天花板的洞口透進了光......也許可以沿著附近的莖蔓爬上去......

scripts.text: I should go back to Arc...
I came back here, but there's no trace of Terra...
scripts.translation: 我又回到這裡，卻沒看見泰拉的蹤跡......

scripts.text: There's only one thing different from the last time..Small particles of an ore are sprinkled around the Sapha's dead body.
scripts.translation: 唯一不同的是，薩法屍體周圍散落著一些礦石粉末。

scripts.text: What was she trying to do with this Sapha?
scripts.translation: 她想對這名薩法做什麼？

scripts.text: I can't just go back to Arc without anything... he'd be so disappointed...
scripts.translation: 我不能空手回去......阿克會很失望......

scripts.text: Hmm, Should I go to the Sapha's village?
scripts.translation: 嗯，要不要去薩法村莊看看？

scripts.text: I can't find any traces of Terra anymore.
scripts.translation: 我再也找不到泰拉留下的蹤跡了。

scripts.text: One thing that bugs me is...These particles of an ore.
scripts.translation: 只有這些礦石粉末讓我在意......

scripts.text: I should go back to Arc and ask about it, or go to Sapha's Village and investigate some more.
scripts.translation: 我該回去問阿克這是什麼，還是去薩法村莊繼續調查？

scripts.text: A giant from the race called Sapha is petrified here.
scripts.translation: 這裡有一名石化的薩法族巨人。

scripts.text: I need to bring back some evidence of this giant in the cave.
scripts.translation: 我得帶些洞穴裡這名巨人的東西回去作證。

scripts.text: What should I bring with me?
It won't come off. It's as if it is a tree rooted on a rock.
scripts.translation: 拔不下來，就像樹紮根在岩石上一樣。

scripts.text: You carefully strip a worn muffler off of the Sapha's neck.
scripts.translation: 你小心地從薩法族脖子上取下一條磨損的圍巾。

scripts.text: We will see if this muffler belongs to Ogen or not.
scripts.translation: 回去確認這是不是奧根的圍巾。

scripts.text: It won't come off. It's as if it is a tree rooted on a rock.
scripts.translation: 拔不下來，就像樹紮根在岩石上一樣。

scripts.text: ... I don't want to take off a dead MAN's pants...

scripts.translation: 你撿起地上散落的一塊布拉迪姆碎片。

scripts.text: ... I don't want to take off a dead MAN's pants...
Now I have the muffler, let's go back to Luik and Snorren.
scripts.translation: 現在拿到了圍巾，回去找盧伊克和斯諾倫吧。

scripts.text: This.. is.. worse than I could have imagined.....
Ogen... this doesn't look like it can be reversed...
scripts.translation: 奧根......看來已經無法恢復原狀了......

scripts.text: No matter how much bradium fluid we inject... Ogen can't come back alive...
scripts.translation: 不管注射多少布拉迪姆溶液......奧根都沒法活過來......

scripts.text: Ogen... really was adament... about protecting that Laphine... to protect Terra.....
scripts.translation: 奧根......真的很執著......為了保護拉斐族......為了保護泰拉......

scripts.text: He did his best 'til the last...
scripts.translation: 直到最後一刻......他都盡了全力。

scripts.text: Ogen... made himself an unbreakable shield...
scripts.translation: 奧根......把自己變成了一面堅不可摧的盾......

scripts.text: Ogen... you can now go back to the bosom of the Motherland...
scripts.translation: 奧根......你現在可以迴歸祖國的懷抱了......

scripts.text: This statue will be a monument to your courage...
scripts.translation: 這座雕像會成為你英勇的紀念......

scripts.text: - - I can't begin to describe the sorrow of losing a close friend... -
scripts.translation: - 失去摯友的悲痛......難以言表...... -

scripts.text: - All I could do was to keep tapping his shoulder... as he quietly sobbed... -
scripts.translation: - 我只能輕拍他的肩膀......看著他默默哭泣...... -

scripts.text: Ogen wouldn't want you to be so sad and depressed.
scripts.translation: 奧根不會希望你這麼悲傷消沉。

scripts.text: This... must be a comfort resting place for Ogen.
scripts.translation: 這一定是奧根安息的地方。

scripts.text: I should go and tell Luik and the townspeople about this...
scripts.translation: 我得去把這件事告訴盧伊克和鎮上的居民......

scripts.text: - Snorren stood up with a bitter smile...
scripts.translation: - 斯諾倫帶著苦澀的笑容站起身......

scripts.text: ...I should go back too... I'm worried about Terra. -
scripts.translation: ......我也該回去了......我很擔心泰拉。 -

scripts.text: Whoa, I almost forgot the ring.
Ogen... was petrified as he covered Terra...
scripts.translation: 奧根......石化時正護著泰拉......

scripts.text: What was going on between them that they would see past their racial differences...?
scripts.translation: 他們之間究竟發生了什麼，竟能超越種族隔閡......？

scripts.text: Before you is a statue made of stone and wood. It's so life-like it's eerie.
scripts.translation: 眼前是一座由石頭和木頭製成的雕像。栩栩如生，令人毛骨悚然。

scripts.text: The trunk of a Tree moderately stretched upward.
There are big thorns here that should be enough to use as footholds to climb up.
scripts.translation: 上面長著粗大的荊棘，可以當作落腳點攀爬。

scripts.text: It's the trunk of a Tree stretched out toward a hole in the ceiling.
scripts.translation: 樹幹一直伸向天花板的洞口。

scripts.text: Big thorns can be used as footholds.
scripts.translation: 粗大的荊棘可以當作落腳點。

scripts.text: By the way, how did that Fairy come this far?
scripts.translation: 對了，那個妖精怎麼會跑到這麼遠的地方？

scripts.text: That Fairy came here by her own accord.
How impudent. She was horribly wounded when she got here.
scripts.translation: 真大膽。她來的時候傷得很重。

scripts.text: Excuse me for interrupting your conversation.
You were talking about a Fairy, would you be kind to tell me the details?
scripts.translation: 你們剛才提到了一個妖精，能告訴我詳情嗎？

scripts.text: Lawine, Come with me to the Refinery later.
scripts.translation: 拉維內，稍後和我去精煉廠。

scripts.text: - The Sapha people are not willing to tell you anything. But the
scripts.translation: - 薩法族不願透露任何資訊。
但那個被抓的妖精可能是泰拉。 -

scripts.text: I heard a fairy was crying and begging, she was badly hurt.
scripts.translation: 我聽見一個妖精在哭喊求救，她傷得很重。

scripts.text: No one understand the words of fairy...
In the end we had no idea what to do.
scripts.translation: 最後我們也不知道該怎麼辦。

scripts.text: Anyway, that fairy is now in prison.
scripts.translation: 總之，那個妖精現在關在監獄裡。

scripts.translation: - 幸好薩法族以為我聽不懂他們的話，

scripts.translation: 但他們一定是在談泰拉...... -

scripts.translation: - 薩法族正在交談，沒有注意到我的動作。 -

scripts.text: - They are talking mostly about common town matters, not much useful information. -
scripts.translation: - 他們主要談論的是城鎮瑣事，沒什麼有用的資訊。 -

scripts.text: - I'd better move away from them before they get suspicious of my presence. -
scripts.translation: - 我最好在他們起疑之前離開這裡。 -

Nsf iu ai sd a sd!
scripts.translation: Nsf iu ai sd a sd!

scripts.text: He seems anxious as he wanders back and forth..
Is he the guard of this prison?
How could an outsider be here...?
How does an outsider like you know that?
scripts.translation: 你這樣的外來者怎麼知道這件事？

scripts.text: And..? What? How can you understand what I'm saying?
scripts.translation: 還有......什麼？你怎麼聽得懂我說話？

scripts.text: Can you understand the words coming out of my mouth?
- I show the ring to Snorren. -
That's amazing. a ring capable of interpreting between different languages... and you were able to come all the way here.
scripts.translation: 這枚戒指竟然能翻譯不同語言，真不可思議。難怪你能一路來到這裡。

scripts.text: I heard there are outsiders helping our people.
scripts.translation: 我聽說有外來者在幫助我們的族人。

scripts.text: You must be one of them!
But where did you hear about that Fairy?
scripts.translation: 不過，你從哪聽說那個妖精的？

scripts.text: Frankly, I want to have a word with that Fairy.
scripts.translation: 說實話，我想和她——那個拉斐族——談談。

scripts.text: But I don't understand their language.
scripts.translation: 但我聽不懂她們的語言。

scripts.text: Why do you want to talk to her?
But I can't just do it arbitrarily...
The reason why I want to have a word with that fairy, I mean Laphine...
scripts.translation: 我想和那個妖精，也就是拉斐族談談，是因為......

scripts.text: I... want to find out if she's got anything to do with my friend...
scripts.translation: 我......想知道她是否和我的朋友......有關......

scripts.text: He said he was curious about the area you are living in and went to check it out. How foolish of him.
scripts.translation: 他說對你們居住的地方很好奇，就去查看了。真是傻。
然後他就再也沒有回來。

scripts.text: After quite a while, that fairy came.
scripts.translation: 過了很久之後，那個妖精出現了。

scripts.text: I don't know what guts she had to just fly into our territory.
scripts.translation: 我真不知道她哪來的膽子，竟敢直接飛進我們的領地。

scripts.text: That fairy just kept on yelling 'a bradium!' 'a bradium!'
scripts.translation: 那個妖精一直喊著“布拉迪姆！布拉迪姆！”

scripts.text: Our village's vigilantes are saying that fairy is affected by the power of bradium and went crazy.
scripts.translation: 村裡的巡邏隊說，那個妖精受到布拉迪姆的力量影響，發瘋了。

scripts.text: That's what Laphine are all like!
They just try to make accesories out of the ore which is our source of life.
scripts.translation: 她們只想用這種作為我們生命之源的礦石做飾品。

scripts.text: They collect anything that possesses magical power.
scripts.translation: 凡是有魔力的東西，她們都收集。

scripts.text: You should calm down a bit... Tell me about that captured Laphine.
scripts.translation: 你先冷靜一點......告訴我那個被抓的拉斐族的事。

scripts.text: Anyways, shortly after Ogen went missing the fairy appears... this is too suspicious...
scripts.translation: 奧根失蹤後不久，那個妖精就出現了......實在可疑......

scripts.text: and that fairy was severely wounded too.
That fairy attacked Ogen as he was trying to peek on your camp.
scripts.translation: 我想......那個妖精在奧根窺探你們營地時襲擊了他。

scripts.text: And she was drawn by Ogen's bradium and came all the way here to find more bradium!
scripts.translation: 她被奧根身上的布拉迪姆吸引，一路來到這裡尋找更多布拉迪姆！

scripts.text: I don't see it that way...
But does that Ore called bradium really possess an overwhelming magical power?
scripts.translation: 可是，那種叫布拉迪姆的礦石真有那麼強的魔力嗎？

scripts.text: Really? But, we Sapha can't live without bradium.
scripts.translation: 真的嗎？可我們薩法族離不開布拉迪姆。

scripts.text: This war with the Laphine... is to protect the bradium from them...
scripts.translation: 我們與拉斐族開戰......就是為了保護布拉迪姆不被她們奪走......

scripts.text: Your people and their people are fighting over the bradium...
scripts.translation: 你們兩族正在為布拉迪姆而戰......

scripts.text: Then how do you see this situation?
scripts.translation: 那你如何看待這種局勢？

scripts.text: It's like some kind of forbidden area...
Anyhow, You are going to ask that fairy about Ogen, right?
scripts.translation: 總之，你打算問那個妖精奧根的事，對吧？

scripts.text: If that's the case, I could interpret between you two...
scripts.translation: 如果是這樣，我可以幫你們翻譯......

scripts.text: Then just wait here for a sec!
I will go and ask Luik about this!
You need to obey the rules to keep a peaceful group life.
scripts.translation: 為了維持群體生活的秩序，你得遵守規則。

scripts.text: This is where people who break the rules are kept overnight.
scripts.translation: 這裡是關押違規者過夜的地方。

scripts.text: Oh. I'm not one of them.
I just have some business here.
Ah, I told you it's not possible Snorren!
I can only put you in a cell for one night!
scripts.translation: 我只能讓你在牢房裡待一晚！
哎呀！盧伊克，不是那回事！

scripts.text: I brought someone who would interpret that fairy's words!
scripts.translation: 我帶了個能翻譯妖精語言的人來！

scripts.text: Shut up! Anyway, we have more things to worry about. This Laphine, we need to treat her wounds...
scripts.translation: 閉嘴！總之，我們還有很多事要擔心。這個拉斐族得先治傷......

scripts.text: Her body is completely different from ours. What should we do?
scripts.translation: 她的身體和我們完全不同。該怎麼辦？

scripts.text: Hey, Snorren! Bring me anything. Anything like herbs!
scripts.translation: 嘿，斯諾倫！給我拿點東西來，什麼草藥之類的！

scripts.text: Herbs? Is her condition that bad?
scripts.translation: 草藥？她情況這麼嚴重嗎？

scripts.text: Can't we fix her with bradium?
scripts.translation: 不能用布拉迪姆治療嗎？

scripts.text: Oh right, She's not Sapha, ey?
scripts.translation: 哦對，她不是薩法族，對吧？

scripts.text: Do you have anything on your mind?
She's a Laphine, right? Then we should ask a Laphine about it...
scripts.translation: 她是拉斐族，對吧？那我們該問問她們該怎麼治療......

scripts.text: Like what we need to treat her...
I can take care of it.
Then hurry up and bring something back...
scripts.translation: 那就快點帶點東西回來......

scripts.text: (I think I have no choice but to go back and ask Arc....)
Hurry up and go find a way to cure this Laphine...
scripts.translation: 快點想辦法治好這個拉斐族......

scripts.text: Then Luik might let us in.
scripts.translation: 那樣盧伊克可能就會讓我們進去。

scripts.text: This.. is one strange looking fruit.
scripts.translation: 這......看起來是種奇怪的果實。

scripts.text: I saw this fruit from time to time, but never thought this would be a cure..?
scripts.translation: 我偶爾見過它，沒想到竟能治病......？

scripts.text: I will take everything you've brought with you!
scripts.translation: 我會收下你帶來的所有東西！

scripts.text: I would need at least 6~7 of these...
Huh? Ah, I think we would need more than what I've brought here... I'll be back.
scripts.translation: 咦？哦，我帶來的可能不夠......我再去拿。

scripts.text: I already told Luik everything about you...
scripts.translation: 我已經把關於你的事告訴盧伊克了......

scripts.text: I'm really confused now...Should I believe your story or not.
scripts.translation: 我現在很困惑......該不該相信你的話。

scripts.text: If it is true that cave really exists and Ogen is hurt...

scripts.text: Sure enough... I, the Sapha Galtun, Strom, apologize to you. I should not have been so quick to despise you.
scripts.translation: 看來如此...我是薩法族加爾圖恩氏族的斯特羅姆，向你道歉。我不該這麼快就輕視你。

scripts.text: I admit that you are a brave soldier, please feel free to visit Manuk.
scripts.translation: 我承認你是位勇敢的戰士，歡迎隨時來馬努克做客。

scripts.text: Although I don't have much to offer, please accept these coins.
scripts.translation: 我沒什麼好東西可送，這些硬幣請收下。

scripts.text: If you need to buy something, you can use them.
scripts.translation: 需要買東西的話，可以用它們。

scripts.text: If you want to show you're so strong...
scripts.translation: 想證明自己有實力的話...

scripts.text: Please find and defeat the Rata and Duneyrr in the cave.
scripts.translation: 就去洞穴裡找到拉塔和杜耶爾，打敗它們。

scripts.text: Here icy climate is not suitable for biological survival, but we do not feel cold,
scripts.translation: 這裡的嚴寒不利於生物生存，不過我們感覺不到冷，

scripts.text: so we're not very concerned about it.
In such cold weather, you are best to don Hillslions fur...
scripts.translation: 天氣這麼冷，最好穿上希斯利安皮毛製成的衣服...

scripts.text: Thank you for collecting the Enriched Bradium for me, it was very helpful.
scripts.translation: 謝謝你幫我收集濃縮布拉迪姆，真是幫了大忙。

scripts.text: We've got more than enough for now though.
Thank you for collecting the Enriched Bradium for me, it was very helpful.
scripts.translation: 謝謝你幫我收集濃縮布拉迪姆，真是幫了大忙。

scripts.text: I hope you can help me again.
scripts.translation: 希望以後還能請你幫忙。

scripts.text: Oh, that will do very well.
On behalf of the Sapha, I extend our thanks to you.
scripts.translation: 我代表薩法族向你致謝。

scripts.text: I hope you can help us again.
scripts.translation: 希望以後還能請你幫忙。

scripts.text: This is where we refine stones.
To prevent our bodies from becoming numb, we need Bradium.
scripts.translation: 為了避免身體麻痺，我們需要布拉迪姆。

scripts.text: From the Bradium we can extract a special element that we need to survive.
scripts.translation: 我們能從中提取生存所需的一種特殊成分。

scripts.text: The mining industry is primary here since our lives depend on it.
scripts.translation: 我們的生活離不開布拉迪姆，因此採礦至關重要。

scripts.text: But the mine has become clogged.
I've already heard that you guys are good soldiers.
scripts.translation: 我聽說你們都是出色的戰士。

scripts.text: Would you mind terminating the Bradium Golem, and bringing back some Bradium for me?
scripts.translation: 能否消滅布拉迪姆石魔，再帶些布拉迪姆回來？

scripts.text: Please hunt Bradium Golem and bring me 20 blended Bradium.
scripts.translation: 請獵殺布拉迪姆石魔，帶回20塊混合布拉迪姆。

scripts.text: How could I be so naive to depend on others?
scripts.translation: 我怎麼這麼天真，竟然指望別人？

scripts.text: We refine Bradium and extract special things from it.
scripts.translation: 我們精煉布拉迪姆，從中提取特殊成分，

scripts.text: Then form that into an injection.
When it is refined it is used to maintain our body cycles.
scripts.translation: 精煉後的布拉迪姆能維持我們的身體機能。

scripts.text: That's why we are quite advanced in this industry.
scripts.translation: 因此，我們在這方面相當先進。

scripts.text: Other industries are also well developed... but...
scripts.translation: 其他行業也發展得不錯...不過...

scripts.text: This is our top priority because it is crucial for our survival.
scripts.translation: 這是我們的首要任務，因為它關係到我們的生存。

scripts.text: Thank you for collecting those items for me.
That should be sufficient for the time being.
Thank you for collecting those items for me.
Hopefully you can help us again.
scripts.translation: 希望以後還能請你幫忙。

scripts.text: These are enough materials for today.
scripts.translation: 今天的材料已經夠用了。

scripts.text: I'll let you know if I need more.
scripts.translation: 如果還需要，我會告訴你。

scripts.text: What can I help you with?
Not yet done with my request?
I need to make more decorations for the Yai.
scripts.translation: 我得繼續給雅伊製作裝飾品。

scripts.text: This place is being used for battle but it is also our home.
scripts.translation: 這裡雖然是戰場，也是我們的家。

scripts.text: We prefer to be alone so we must each have our own Yai.
scripts.translation: 我們喜歡獨處，所以每個人都需要自己的雅伊。

scripts.text: Though we are in a military base we should take care of each Yai.
scripts.translation: 即使身處軍事基地，也得好好佈置自己的雅伊。

scripts.text: I am not a soldier but we hope all of us to be as confident as they are.
scripts.translation: 我不是士兵，但希望大家都能像他們一樣自信。

scripts.text: I would like to support all Laphine with my skills.
scripts.translation: 我想用自己的手藝支援所有拉斐族。

scripts.text: So I want to help make decorations for everyone's Yai.
scripts.translation: 所以我想幫大家制作雅伊的裝飾品。

scripts.text: I need more materials to make them.
I heard that a water ghost has been appearing in the cave.
scripts.translation: 聽說洞穴裡出現了水鬼。

scripts.text: Can you bring me 15 Crystallized Teardrop and 15 Fluorescent Liquid?
scripts.translation: 能幫我帶來15個結晶淚滴和15份熒光液嗎？

scripts.text: Can you bring me 15 Crystallized Teardrop and 15 Fluorescent Liquid?
scripts.translation: 能幫我帶來15個結晶淚滴和15份熒光液嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I'm sure that you have your own business to attend to.
scripts.translation: 我知道你也有自己的事要忙。

scripts.text: I feel embarrassed asking a favor from you, as a Laphine.
scripts.translation: 身為拉斐族，卻向你開口求助，真讓我有些不好意思。

scripts.text: But, why are you trying to be involved in our business yet you won't take up our request?
scripts.translation: 既然你想插手我們的事，為什麼又不肯接受委託呢？
所有成年拉斐族都有自己的雅伊。

scripts.text: They're essential for all Laphine to live in since we are very private people.
scripts.translation: 我們很注重隱私，所以雅伊是生活中不可或缺的一部分。

scripts.text: That's it. We sometimes invite our friends or guests to our Yai.
scripts.translation: 就是這樣。我們有時會邀請朋友或客人到自己的雅伊做客。

scripts.text: And decorations for Yai are quite important to us...
scripts.translation: 而雅伊的裝飾對我們來說很重要...

scripts.text: We Laphine care about ourselves and our Yai as well.
scripts.translation: 我們拉斐族既關心自己，也珍視自己的雅伊。

scripts.text: We are far away from our hometown now...
If we don't have this kind of hobby, there's nothing to enjoy here.
scripts.translation: 要是沒有這樣的愛好，在這裡就沒什麼樂趣了。

scripts.text: Hm? Oh, can't you see I'm busy?
scripts.translation: 嗯？哦，你沒看到我正忙著嗎？

scripts.text: I'm making ornaments though, if you must know.
scripts.translation: 我在做裝飾品呢，非要問的話。

scripts.text: That's very dangerous. Do you want to die..?!

scripts.translation: 你這是在無視可愛的寵物嗎？！

scripts.text: We've been able to get Pickys and even Zealotus!
scripts.translation: 我們連小雞和澤洛圖斯都能馴養了！

scripts.text: No way, even if you ask me...
Then let me know why you object to this.
scripts.translation: 那你倒是說說，為什麼反對？

scripts.text: It's too dangerous. I've trained monsters before.
scripts.translation: 這太危險了。我以前訓練過魔物。

scripts.text: Hillslions look cute and adorable, but it's not very realistic.
scripts.translation: 希斯利安看起來很可愛，但真要養起來可沒那麼簡單。

scripts.text: I've tried to train them... but I couldn't.
scripts.translation: 我試過訓練它們...但沒成功。

scripts.text: How can we can train them as a cute pet...?
scripts.translation: 怎麼可能把它們訓練成可愛的寵物...？

scripts.text: It would definitely try to escape from us...
scripts.translation: 它們肯定會想辦法逃走...

scripts.text: Then he would become very awful.
Can't we control them with magical power?
scripts.translation: 不能用魔法控制它們嗎？
我們以前不是成功過嗎......

scripts.text: Ah, Taab isn't flexible at all.
scripts.translation: 唉，塔布真是一點都不肯變通。

scripts.text: Have you hunted the Runaway Dandelion?
scripts.translation: 你獵殺過逃跑的蒲公英嗎？

scripts.text: Here's something Rin was storing here.
scripts.translation: 這是琳恩寄存在這裡的東西。

scripts.text: This is Rin's cherished treasure box...
I know you haven't terminated the Runaway Dandelion yet.
scripts.translation: 我知道你還沒消滅逃跑的蒲公英。

scripts.text: Don't take me for a fool.
I will forward everything to Rin.
I can remember that I've heard about you from Rin.
scripts.translation: 我記得琳恩跟我提起過你。

scripts.text: But Rin likes you, so that must mean that you're nice.
scripts.translation: 既然她喜歡你，你應該是個好人。

scripts.text: I'm not sure that you're involved in it.
scripts.translation: 我不確定你和這件事有什麼關係。

scripts.text: I can go through this study deeper with your assistance.
scripts.translation: 有你的幫助，我就能深入研究這件事了。

scripts.text: I will try to make these Dragon eggs into cute pets.
scripts.translation: 我會試著把這些龍蛋培育成可愛的寵物。

scripts.text: Come back after a day to check on the progress.
scripts.translation: 一天後再回來看看進展吧。

scripts.text: Draco was being kept in the nest just before hatching. Please collect 10 Dragon eggs for me.
scripts.translation: 飛龍孵化前會待在巢裡。請幫我收集10枚龍蛋。

scripts.text: You know, those are hard to hatch in captivity.
scripts.translation: 要知道，這些蛋在人工環境下很難孵化。

scripts.text: Those eggs are about to hatch now.
scripts.translation: 這些蛋馬上就要孵化了。

scripts.text: I will investigate those back home.
scripts.translation: 我會把它們帶回去研究。

scripts.text: For now I still need more time.
scripts.translation: 這些蛋馬上就要孵化了。我會把它們帶回去研究。眼下我還需要一些時間。

scripts.text: Can you come back here tomorrow?
Do you want to help me gather more Dragon eggs today?
scripts.translation: 今天能再幫我收集一些龍蛋嗎？

scripts.text: I want to try many things with those eggs.
scripts.translation: 我想用這些蛋嘗試不同的方法。

scripts.text: Ok. You have your own business here.
scripts.translation: 好吧，你還有自己的事要忙。
我正在研究可愛的寵物。

scripts.text: Ash-vacuum has several monsters that I think could become cute pets.
scripts.translation: 阿什真空有幾種魔物，我覺得它們可以成為寵物。

scripts.text: The objective is one Dragon egg!
Can you bring me a Dragon Egg?
scripts.translation: 能給我帶一枚龍蛋來嗎？

scripts.text: There would be Dragon nest in the cave you found out.
scripts.translation: 你發現的那個洞穴裡應該有龍巢。

scripts.text: There should be nice Dragon Eggs.
scripts.translation: 裡面應該有不錯的龍蛋。

scripts.text: Let's work together to make them as pets.
scripts.translation: 我們一起把它們馴成寵物吧。

scripts.text: I know it's not the easiest task.
But I refuse to give up.
I will make it into a cute pet someday.
scripts.translation: 總有一天，我會把它們培養成可愛的寵物。

scripts.text: Would you just give up making exogamous beings into cute pets...
scripts.translation: 你能不能放棄把異族生物培養成寵物的想法...

scripts.text: Notice : We thought that all of the Dandelion gang were terminated.
scripts.translation: 珍藏寶箱。 告示：我們以為蒲公英團伙已經全被消滅了，

scripts.text: I've heard that there was a Dandelion's black clothing found in Ash-Vacuum.
scripts.translation: 聽說有人在阿什真空發現了蒲公英成員的黑色衣物。

scripts.text: I need someone to find the Dandelion and terminate them.
scripts.translation: .我需要有人找到並消滅那名蒲公英成員。

scripts.text: I can provide a treasure box that I cherish.
scripts.translation: 我願意拿珍藏的寶箱作報酬。

scripts.text: I've heard a rumor that he's in a cave somewhere..!
scripts.translation: 聽說他躲在某個洞穴裡...！ 附註：

scripts.text: PS> They have a bad reputation...
scripts.translation: 他們名聲很差...你最好別獨自前往.

scripts.text: So you may not want to go alone...
PSS> I can't reward you directly...
'Pinedel' will reward you once the deed is done..!
scripts.translation: 完成後由“派恩德爾”給你獎勵...！

scripts.text: No, I won't get involved in it.
scripts.translation: 是否接受琳恩的委託？不，我不想捲入此事。

scripts.text: I've already decided to take the request.
scripts.translation: 我已經決定接受這項委託。

scripts.text: There must be someone who remove the wanted notice paper.
scripts.translation: 看來有人把通緝令撕掉了。

scripts.text: We just got fresh eggs from the dragon nest.
scripts.translation: 我們剛從龍巢取來新鮮的蛋。

scripts.text: We just got fresh eggs from the dragon nest.
scripts.translation: 我們剛從龍巢取來新鮮的蛋。

scripts.text: We just got fresh eggs from the dragon nest.
scripts.translation: 我們剛從龍巢取來新鮮的蛋。

scripts.text: It looks like you're carrying too many things.
scripts.translation: 看起來你帶的東西太多了。

scripts.text: Why not put some of your items in storage and come back?
scripts.translation: 不如先把一些物品存進倉庫，再回來吧？

scripts.text: Do you know about the Ring of the Ancient Wise King? If you wear that Ring, you can talk to animals.
scripts.translation: 你聽說過古代睿智之王戒指嗎？戴上它就能和動物交談。

scripts.text: I don't know if it is a legend based on truth or not... but something like that would come in pretty handy.
scripts.translation: 不知道這個傳說是否屬實...不過要真有這樣的東西，肯定很方便。

scripts.text: Outside of the Expedition Camp, There's a race of animals which uses a mysterious language not used in Midgard.
scripts.translation: 遠征營地外生活著一種動物，它們使用的神秘語言在米德加爾特並不存在。

scripts.text: We don't know if they are friend or foe, but it will be much easier for our research here if we could find out.
scripts.translation: 我們不知道它們是敵是友。如果能查清楚，對我們在這裡開展研究會很有幫助。

scripts.text: So, the Triple Alliance Research Group is working together to find out. I would like to know how far the ^0000ff Arunafeltz Linguist^000000's decoding process is. Would you go and find out for me?
scripts.translation: 因此，三方聯盟研究小組正在合作調查。我想知道^0000ff阿魯納菲茲語學家^000000的破譯進度。能替我去問問嗎？

scripts.text: The ^0000ff Arunafeltz Linguist^000000 should be on the second floor of the Alliance Headquarters.
scripts.translation: ^0000ff阿魯納菲茲語學家^000000應該在聯盟總部二樓。

scripts.text: Outside of the Expedition Camp, There's a race who uses a mysterious language which is not used in Midgard
scripts.translation: 遠征營地外生活著一種生物，它們使用米德加爾特沒有的神秘語言。

scripts.text: We don't know if they are friend or foe, one thing for sure is it will be more easier for our research here.

scripts.translation: 三方聯盟研究小組正在合作調查。我想知道^0000ff阿魯納菲茲語學家^000000的破譯進度。你能替我打聽一下嗎？

scripts.text: Go to a big building in center of the Expedition Camp and inside that building, meet ^0000ff Arunafeltz Linguist^000000 and ask him how far his progress is.
scripts.translation: 去遠征營地中央的大樓，在裡面找^0000ff阿魯納菲茲語學家^000000問問進展。

scripts.text: The ^0000ff Arunafeltz Linguist^000000 should be on the second floor of the Alliance Headquarters.
scripts.translation: ^0000ff阿魯納菲茲語學家^000000應該在聯盟總部二樓。

scripts.text: - He's making a grim face at a flooding pile of research documents. -
scripts.translation: - 他愁眉苦臉地看著堆積如山的研究資料。 -

scripts.text: t seems like you've done much for us. I thank you for that.
scripts.translation: 看來你為我們做了不少事，謝謝你。

scripts.text: Can you see this? The amount of these research documents?
scripts.translation: 你看這些研究資料，數量多得驚人。

scripts.text: It is a good thing that we finally decoded the other world's language... it's just too much.
scripts.translation: 終於破譯了異世界的語言，確實是好事...就是資料實在太多了。

scripts.text: We can't always accompany a Linguist for an interpretion... We need to communicate with those other world races in order to explore this world...
scripts.translation: 我們不能總讓語學家陪著翻譯...要探索這個世界，就得和異世界的種族交流...

scripts.text: To store this amount of information will need a super computer the size of this headquarter building and its processing speed will be very very slow.
scripts.translation: 要存下這麼多資料，需要一臺和總部大樓一樣大的超級計算機，而且處理速度還會很慢。

scripts.text: Sigh... Anyways, If there's any way to store an enormous amount of data, I should be able to make a very-small portable translator.
scripts.translation: 唉...總之，要是能找到儲存海量資料的方法，我就能造出一臺小巧的便攜翻譯器。

scripts.text: I heard that by using a Magical Spell of Rune-Midgarts, you can transpose data to a magical power and lock it into a gem... I'd like some suggestions from the Rune-Midgarts Magician.
scripts.translation: 我聽說盧恩·米德加茲王國的魔法能把資料轉化為魔力，封存在寶石裡...我想聽聽王國魔法師的建議。

scripts.text: Would you be kind to ask them for help?
scripts.translation: 能請你去問問他們，幫忙想想辦法嗎？

scripts.text: While you are gone, I be here organizing these documents.
scripts.translation: 你去的時候，我會留在這裡整理這些資料。

scripts.text: To store this amount of information will need a super computer with a size of this headquarter building. and its processing speed will be very very slow...
scripts.translation: 要存下這麼多資料，需要一臺和總部大樓一樣大的超級計算機，處理速度還會很慢...

scripts.text: Sigh... Anyways, If there's any way to store an enormous amount of data, I could be able to make a very-small portable translator.
scripts.translation: 唉...總之，要是能找到儲存海量資料的方法，我就能造出一臺小巧的便攜翻譯器。

scripts.text: I heard that by using the Magical Spell of Rune-Midgarts, you could transpose a data to a magical power and lock it into a gem....I'd like to get some suggestion from the Magician of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation: 我聽說盧恩·米德加茲王國的魔法能把資料轉化為魔力，再封存在寶石裡...我想聽聽王國魔法師的建議。

scripts.text: Would you be kind to ask them for help?
scripts.translation: 能請你去問問他們，幫忙想想辦法嗎？

scripts.text: While you are gone, I be here organizing these documents.
scripts.translation: 你去的時候，我會留在這裡整理這些資料。

scripts.text: Inputting data into a gem with a magical power... It's something you can't do with a technology... It's a bit resentful to admit, but it's magnificent.
scripts.translation: 把資料輸入蘊含魔力的寶石...這是科技做不到的事...雖然不太甘心承認，但真了不起。

scripts.text: Well then, I should be working on making a machine to read the magical data in this Gem so we could use them right away.
scripts.translation: 那麼，我得造一臺能讀取寶石中魔法資料的機器，這樣我們就能馬上使用這些資料。

scripts.text: Fortunately, It won't be as hard as we thought.
scripts.translation: 幸好這不會像我們想的那麼難。

scripts.text: If we transform a magical power wave to an eletric signal and connect it to a human body, then transmit a data to a brain directly. That will allow us to receive and understand a data without any loading process.
scripts.translation: 如果把魔力波轉換成電訊號並連線到人體，再把資料直接傳入大腦，就能不經載入，直接接收並理解資料。

scripts.text: I don't have time to explain everything. I have to start the work right away.
scripts.translation: 我沒時間解釋所有細節，得馬上動手。

scripts.text: With all preperation done, allow me about one hour to finish this thing.
scripts.translation: 準備工作都做好後，再給我一個小時左右完成它。

scripts.text: Sigh, What should I do now?!
- Dorance is walking here and there -
scripts.translation: - 多蘭斯焦躁不安地來回踱步。

scripts.text: What should I do?! Ain't I REALLY a genius?!

scripts.text: And while you were helping us, I believe you've seen and visited many places here in the other world.

scripts.translation: 偶爾和人聊聊天還挺放鬆的。

scripts.text: - You can't understand what he's saying. -
Maybe that device can be controlled from here.
scripts.translation: 也許可以從這裡操作那個裝置。

scripts.text: You press the device buttons and it suddenly becomes dark.
scripts.translation: 你按下裝置的按鈕，周圍突然變暗。

scripts.text: You decide to leave it alone.
The device has already been activated.
You must wait for the controls to reset.

scripts.translation: 這裡有個可以操作的裝置。

scripts.text: You might be able to control that device from here.
Panels have appeared across the ledge.
scripts.translation: 平臺邊緣出現了控制面板。

scripts.text: You decide not to control the device.
scripts.translation: 你決定不操作這個裝置。
